chapters.title: A goal. A budget. An agent that follows both.
chapters.narration: Meet OY Orders. Tell the agent: buy me a coffee pass within my budget. It compares signed offers and explains every refusal.

chapters.title: Tight budget? No purchase.
chapters.narration: With one test ADA, nothing fits. The fake cheap price fails its signature. The cheaper item is wrong. The real coffee offers cost too much. The agent spends nothing.

chapters.title: Three bad deals refused. One valid deal selected.
chapters.narration: Raise the budget to two test ADA. The agent selects the genuine matching offer. Our catalog deliberately includes bad deals. This decision uses rules, not a language model.

chapters.title: The selected offer becomes a real purchased pass.
chapters.narration: Authorize the selected deal. Our actual testnet purchase paid the supplier on Cardano through x four oh two. The pass arrived. Solana held the separate agent reward until delivery checks succeeded.

chapters.title: 11 independent checks before the reward releases.
chapters.narration: Open the proof. NOW Nodes supplies the original Cardano payment records. An official Chainlink C R E simulation rechecks the shopping decision, the signed pass and the Solana escrow. Eleven checks passed. The reward released.

chapters.title: A signed answer can still be wrong.
chapters.narration: There is another trap. A valid signature can hide a false transaction fee. Fresh source records catch it. In a separate paid test, a wrong delivery kept the reward locked until its expiry refund.

chapters.title: Your goal. Your budget. Inspectable delivery.
chapters.narration: This is an edited tour of authentic app captures with synthetic narration. It uses operator funded test coins, an OY demo catalog and a trusted relayer. The voucher cannot buy real coffee. OY Orders: a shopping agent with inspectable delivery.
